profile_text.body:
XPENG INC. is a public company headquartered in Guangzhou, traded under the ticker XPEV, with CIK 0001810997. Its Spanish market site presents a fully electric range under the slogan "Xpande tu mundo" and states that the company has been turning what the world calls the future into reality since 2014.

The site describes the G6, G9 and P7+ models as combining artificial intelligence, advanced driver assistance systems and the 800-volt SEPA 2.0 electric platform, which the company says allows charging from 10% to 80% in 12 minutes across the range. All three models carry the DGT CERO label and a warranty of up to 7 years / 160.000 km. The site invites visitors to leave their details to arrange a test drive or request more information.

The data controller named on the site is CAETANO AUTOMOTIVE ESPAÑA DISTRIBUCIÓN, S.L.U. Financing examples are offered subject to approval by Open Bank, S.A., including a G6 RWD Standard Range cash price of 41.122,71€ and a financed price of 37.522,71 €. The data contains no litigation involving the company.
